text:
net checkout

(pending) -checkout-> [send] -checkout-> (sending)
(free) -lock-> [send]
(sending) -checkout-> [finish] -outcome-> (ended)
@unlock: [finish] -lock-> (free)
(ended) -outcome-> [close] -checkout-> (done)
@unlock data {"id": "desk"}

domain outcome.outcome "returned" "failed"
domain outcome.checkout.tries 0 1 2.5
domain checkout.urgent true false
final (done), (sending) + (ended)
invariant "lock" (free) + (sending) + (ended) = 1
invariant 2 * (pending) + (done)
